ModMetaData.name: Player-Only Apparel Bypass
ModMetaData.author: Codex
ModMetaData.description: Lets player-controlled colonists ignore HAR apparel race restrictions on a per-pawn basis for outfit optimization and wear checks. Includes a default behavior setting for newly managed colonists and an optional pawn gizmo to toggle bypass on or off per colonist, while leaving NPC apparel generation unchanged.
